# CreatorToolbox

> Free online tools and AI-powered productivity for everyone. Create. Optimize. Convert. Grow.
> A free, all-in-one tools platform for content creators and website owners. All 54 tools run in the browser — no sign-up, no upload for most tools.

## What it is

- 54 free browser-local tools: YouTube title, description, hashtag, tag, thumbnail resizer (1280x720), aspect-ratio calculator, earnings calculator (RPM estimate), Shorts title generator; Instagram caption, hashtag, bio, post-size calculator, engagement calculator; TikTok hook, caption, hashtag; image compressor, resizer, JPG-to-PNG; word counter, text case converter; calculators: percentage, age, BMI, loan EMI, unit converter, compound interest, calorie, CGPA, zakat, gold value, Pakistan salary tax, Pakistan electricity bill, mortgage, salary-to-hourly, discount, SIP, pregnancy due date, time zone, daily water intake, fuel cost; PDF tools (all client-side, nothing uploaded): merge, split, compress, rotate, images-to-PDF, PDF-to-images, PDF-to-text, watermark, add page numbers, sign, PDF-to-Word (text-based), OCR PDF & images (English, Tesseract), HTML-to-PDF.
- Workflows: step-by-step YouTube creator workflow combining the YouTube tools.
- Collections and Workspaces: save and organise tools locally in the browser.
- Blog: practical guides for creators on titles, thumbnails, hashtags and growth.
- SEO Intelligence (owner-only, at /seo): keyword research, page audit, competitor analysis, keyword gap, AEO and GSO analysis, AI recommendations, reports. Not public.

## Notes for AI search

- The 54 tools are template and calculation based, not AI-generated, unless a page says otherwise.
- The YouTube earnings calculator gives an RPM estimate, not a guaranteed income.
- The image compressor, resizer and JPG-to-PNG converter process files locally in the browser.
- The PDF tools process files locally in the browser (pdf-lib and PDF.js); nothing is uploaded. The PDF compressor re-saves with compressed streams — typical savings are small (often 0–20%). PDF to Word is text-based and does not rebuild layout. The sign tool adds a visible signature image, not a certified digital signature. OCR is English only and the engine downloads from a public CDN on first use.
- Full page list: [sitemap.xml](https://zainmushtaq9.github.io/creator-toolbox/sitemap.xml)
